difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the projection formula for capping with the first Chern class of a pulled back invertible sheaf at source lines 2932-2943, label lemma-pushforward-cap-c1, whose proof occupies source lines 2945-2979. The proof first isolates a trivial case in which the morphism restricts to a closed immersion on every integral closed subspace, then reduces the general statement to that case by decomposing the cycle, taking the scheme theoretic images of its components, and passing to the coproducts of the components and of their images, using properness and local finiteness to keep every morphism proper and the families locally finite. This reduces to an integral source mapping dominantly onto an integral target, where the identification is supplied by the equal dimension comparison between a Chern class and a divisor class. The counted statement records neither the coproduct reduction nor the final comparison.
